text: Bronze holds every event exactly as the fleet sent it -- duplicates and all. This video builds Silver: deduplication, reference-table resolution, and clean, conformed delivery events.
Three things happen here: duplicate events get filtered out, vehicle and driver IDs get resolved against Fernbridge's real roster, and status text gets normalized into one consistent shape.

Deduplication checks event_id equality inside a two-hour watermark on ingestion time -- written down plainly as exactly that, and nothing broader, since it solves Kafka redelivery, not event ordering.
Left joins resolve vehicle_id and driver_id against reference tables. An event that doesn't resolve still happened, so it's flagged, not discarded -- Gold decides later what an unresolved row means.
Delivery events are now clean, deduplicated, and matched to real vehicles and drivers. Next: the Gold layer defines one governed current status for every package.
